Study Group Meet Up! (opt in space for women) 

Hey everyone, my name is Sammie! I'm a 4th year double major in Data Science and Computer Science, and I'm currently enrolled in this class. (I'm from rural Oregon, I'm on the Cal women's ultimate frisbee team, and I love to skate)

I reserved Room B1M20E in Kresge Engineering & Mathematical Sciences Library (capacity 15 people) from 12pm-2pm next Wednesday, Sept 3.

If you self-identify as a woman, please show up so we can get a study group going / exchange numbers!

Introduce yourself on this thread in the meantime!
